items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: And they had Joe Howard playing trumpet.

ctx.x: They had Walter Deku on piano. Emile Biggoin on violin. And they had Bill Matthews was playing drum.

And they had Joe Howard playing trumpet. Was there a clarinet did you mention? Yes. No. No. Who was the clarinet? Who was the clarinet? Was there a clarinet did you mention? The clarinet player was uh, The clarinet player was uh, Louis Nelson. Biggoin. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Can you tell us anything about your, anything else about your uncle? Uh, when did he die about? I don't even know. No. Actually, you wouldn't know, but I just wondered if you ever talked to me about it, you know? That's right. Or what other bands…
